description:

The fragrance opens with the sweet indulgence of milk candy, gradually melting into the soft creaminess of heliotrope and sugarcane. At the base, smooth vanilla blends with sensual musk and the golden warmth of ambrofix, creating a silky, radiant trail that lingers on the skin.

Nebras Elixir is a luminous solar gourmand. It balances the elegance of white heliotrope with the playful sweetness of milk candy and cream, while vanilla lends indulgence and depth. Musk and ambrofix weave a glowing veil, leaving behind a sensation as soft as silk and as radiant as sunlight.

The fragrance opens with a burst of freshness and tropical sweetness. Bergamot, a citrusy and slightly spicy note, provides a zesty and invigorating start. Coconut adds a creamy and exotic twist, evoking images of palm-fringed beaches and tropical paradises.

As the scent develops, it transitions into the heart notes, where it becomes more floral and aromatic. Jasmine, known for its rich and intoxicating floral aroma, is complemented by the sweet and citrusy nuances of orange blossom. In the base, La African Drummer settles into a warm and inviting drydown. Ambroxan, a synthetic ambergris note, contributes a woody and ambry quality, enhancing the longevity of the fragrance. Vanilla provides a sweet and comforting richness, while musk adds a subtle, animalic undertone, creating an overall sense of warmth and sensuality.

The fragrance opens with a fresh and vibrant blend of citrus and fruit, transitioning to a delicate harmony of florals in the heart, before settling into a warm, woody base with vanilla sweetness.

name: CERAMIC HOLLOW VASE BLACK AND WHITE SET
CATERPILLAR ART GEOMETRY SEMI CIRCULAR SCULPTURE
CARAMEL OUD by ARD AL ZAAFARAN EDP 100ML
description:
Caramel Oud Eau de Parfum by Ard Al Zafraan housed in a 100ml bottle, this scent is perfect for those who seek a warm and opulent aroma that leaves a lasting impression. Whether for special occasions or daily wear, Caramel Oud offers a balanced yet striking scent that stands out.


Key Features:

Unique Scent Profile: A rich combination of sweet caramel and earthy oud for an unforgettable fragrance.
Versatile Use: Suitable for both casual and formal occasions, adding a touch of elegance to any setting.
Long-Lasting: Crafted from premium ingredients to ensure that the scent remains strong and captivating throughout the day.
Elegant Packaging: Presented in a stylish 100ml bottle, making it an excellent choice for gifting or personal indulgence.


Fragrance Notes:

Top Notes: Sweet caramel and warm spices.
Middle Notes: Woody oud and amber.
Base Notes: Smoky incense and musk.

name: BURBERRY WEEKEND 50ML
description: Weekend Perfume by Burberry, The powdery fragrance of Weekend evokes the feeling of a relaxing weekend in the country. While there are over a dozen notes to this scent, it finds cohesion in the way each scent compliments and challenges the others. Nectarine a peach blossom create a fruity and floral top note which is strengthened by the Mediterranean flower mignonette. Other floral notes in the bouquet include rose hip, iris, hyacinth and violet root. The cedar and musk base provide a firm footing for these delicate scents.

name: BRIOCHE VANILLE by LATTAFA EDP 100ML (UNISEX)
description:
Lattafa Pride Brioche Vanille Eau de Parfum is an exquisite blend of gourmand sweetness and floral elegance. The fragrance opens with the bright citrus of bergamot, harmonized by the soft, airy floral touch of freesia and a delectable brioche accord that evokes the comforting scent of freshly baked pastries. As it transitions, the heart notes introduce the powdery, almond-like heliotrope and the rich, resinous warmth of fir balsam, creating a cozy, yet refined feel. The base is a decadent mix of sweet vanilla, creamy praline, and the smooth, amber-like depth of benzoin, leaving a lasting, indulgent impression.


Top Notes: Bergamot, Freesia, Brioche Accord

Middle Notes: Heliotrope, Fir Balsam

Base Notes: Benzoin, Vanilla, Praline

name: BRIGHT PEACH by MAISON ALHAMBRA EDP 80ML
description:
It's a floral, woody fragrance infused in the exotic gourmand scents making every one that wears it stand out with its aroma still trailing after he/she hadlong left the scene. A very sensual and aromatic scent that every one who has taste for good perfumes will love. A combination of floral and woody accord form the top, middle and base notes.

Top notes are Peach, Blood Orange and Green Leaves; middle note is Patchouli; base notes are Honey and Cognac.

name: BOOZY CHERRY by PENDORA SCENTS EDP 100ML
description:
Descrizione
Dettagli del prodotto
Boozy Cherry by Pendora Scents is a unisex fragrance from the oriental floral family.

Immerse yourself in the sweetness and luxury of Boozy Cherry by Pendora Scents, a fragrance that embodies oriental elegance with a gourmand touch. The top notes open with an enveloping explosion of bitter almond, black cherry and cherry liqueur, creating a rich and delicious start. At the heart of the fragrance, the juicy sweetness of black cherry blends with ripe plum, Turkish rose and exotic sambac jasmine, adding depth and floral refinement. The base notes leave an unforgettable and enveloping impression, with warm vanilla, tonka bean, spicy cinnamon, Peruvian balsam, resinous benzoin, creamy sandalwood, aromatic cloves, cedar wood , earthy patchouli and vetiver. Boozy Cherry by Pendora Scents is not just a perfume, but a sensorial journey that evokes gourmand pleasures and oriental refinement. Discover the irresistible charm of Boozy Cherry and let yourself be seduced by its aura of luxury and sweetness.




Top notes: Bitter Almond, Black Cherry, Cherry Liqueur

Heart notes: Black Cherry, Plum, Turkish Rose, Sambac Jasmine

Base notes: Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Cinnamon, Peru Balsam, Benzoin, Sandalwood, Cloves, Cedar Wood, Patchouli, Vetiver

name: BLACK OPIUM by YSL EDP 90ML
description:
Yves Saint Laurent Black Opium is a popular, glamorous, and bold floral gourmand fragrance for women, launched in 2014. It is characterized by a strong black coffee accord mixed with white flowers and vanilla. The scent is considered confident and edgy, suitable for evening wear, and is often packaged in a black glittery bottle.



Top Notes: Black Coffee Accord, Pear, Green Mandarin
Heart Notes: Orange Blossom, Jasmine Sambac, Solar Notes
Base Notes: Vanilla, Patchouli, Cedarwood

name: BLACK AND WHITE STRIPED FLOWERS VASE BIG-80,000 AND SMALL-65,000
BINT HOORAN by ARD AL ZAAFARAN EDP 100ML
description:
Bint Hooran Black by Ard Al Zaafaran is an affordable,, 100ml Eau de Parfum oriental-woody fragrance designed for both men and women, featuring a, deep, rich profile of spicy, musky, and floral notes. It is characterized by its long-lasting, bold, and sensual aroma that, suits evening wear and cooler seasons.

Key Features & Scent Profile:

Aroma: A "deeper, richer" version of the original, known for spicy, woody, and musky notes.

Fragrance Type: Oriental Floral.

Key Notes: Often features Vanilla, Tuberose, Sweet Almond, Jasmine, Musk, Tonka Bean, and Cacao Pod.
Longevity: Known for being long-lasting, sometimes cited as 72+ hours.

Ideal For: Evening wear and special occasions due to its intense nature.

name: BINT HOORAN ROSE by ARD AL ZAAFARAN EDP 100ML
description:
A captivating Floral Fruity Gourmand fragrance for women with notes of strawberry, gardenia & musk.

This perfume blends rich floral notes with a warm, woody base, creating a scent that is both enchanting and enduring. Ard Al Zaafaran Bint Hooran Rose Passion 100ml EDP is perfect for any occasion, ensuring you leave a lasting impression. Its long-lasting fragrance ensures you feel confident and poised throughout the day. Embrace the passion and allure with this exquisite perfume.

name: BARAKKAT ROUGE 540 by FRAGRANCE WORLD
description:
Barakkat Rouge 540 perfume has a blend of Oriental and floral notes which leaves a long lasting smell. An eau de parfum born from Barakkat.


Luminous and sophisticated, Barakkat Rouge 540 lays on the skin like an amber floral and woody breeze. A poetic alchemy composed by Fragrance World, where the aerial notes of jasmine and the radiance of saffron carry mineral facets of ambergris and woody tones of a freshly cut cedar wood. A graphic and highly condensed signature.

name: BADE'E AL OUD SUBLIME by LATTAFA EDP 100ML
description:
Bade'e Al Oud Sublime by Lattafa Perfumes is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for women and men. Bade'e Al Oud Sublime was launched in 2023. Top notes are Apple, Litchi and Rose; middle notes are Plum and Jasmine; base notes are Moss, Vanilla and Patchouli.


Lattafa Badee Al Oud Sublime is a luxurious, woody fragrance with a hint of sweetness. It is a perfect blend of oud, sandalwood, and musk for a truly sublime experience.

name: BADE'E AL OUD NOBLE BLUSH by LATTAFA EDP 100ML
description:
Lattafa Badee Al Oud Noble Blush (2024) is a popular, affordable unisex Eau de Parfum described as a creamy, powdery, and romantic "rose milk and almond" fragrance. It opens with rose milk, has a heart of meringue and almond, and settles into vanilla, sandalwood, and musk, often noted for being long-lasting with a "sexy girly" vibe. 

Key Details

Fragrance Profile: Floral Fruity Gourmand

Scent Notes:

Top: Rose Milk

Heart: Almond, Meringue

Base: Sandalwood, Vanilla, Musk

Vibe: Creamy, sweet, and luxurious with a "makeupy" scent.

Performance: Generally reported as having good longevity.
Comparisons: Users have noted similarities to a "creamy strawberry milkshake" and occasionally, the vibe of Versace Crystal Noir.

name: BADE'E AL OUD HONOUR AND GLORY by LATTAFA EDP 100ML
description: Bade'e Al Oud Honor & Glory was launched in 2023. Top notes are Pineapple and Creme Brulee; middle notes are Cinnamon, Turmeric, Black Pepper and Benzoin; base notes are Vanilla, Sandalwood, Cashmeran and Moss.

name: BADE'E AL OUD FOR GLORY by LATTAFA EDP 100ML
description: Lattafa Bade’e Al Oud Oud for Glory is a popular, affordable unisex oriental-woody fragrance known as a clone of Initio’s Oud for Greatness. It features strong notes of saffron, lavender, nutmeg, patchouli, and agarwood (oud). Known for excellent longevity and a bold, smoky, and slightly sweet scent profile, it is best suited for evening wear.

name: BADE'E AL OUD AMETHYST by LATTAFA EDP 100ML
description: Bade'e Al Oud Amethyst by Lattafa Perfumes is a Oriental Vanilla fragrance for women and men. Bade'e Al Oud Amethyst was launched in 2021. Top notes are Pink Pepper and Bergamot; middle notes are Turkish Rose, Bulgarian Rose and Jasmine; base notes are Agarwood (Oud), Amber and Vanilla.

name: AVENTOS FOR HIM by FRAGRANCE WORLD EDP 100ML
description:
Aventos Blue for Him by Fragrance World is an affordable, long-lasting Eau de Parfum (100ml) popular in Nigeria, often described as a clean, soapy, and fresh citrus scent for men. Featuring notes of bergamot, apple, lavender, pepper, and cedarwood, it is frequently described as a versatile, everyday fragrance suitable for casual or office wear.

Key Details of Aventos Blue for Him:

Scent Profile: Described as fresh, citrusy, and soapy with a woody base. It is often compared to clean and modern scents, suitable for the "modern man".

Performance: Generally reviewed as long-lasting, though some reviews consider it a moderate, "arm's length" scent rather than a loud projector.

Brand: Produced by Fragrance World, a popular UAE-based perfume house known for affordable alternatives.
Versatility: Considered appropriate for year-round wear, both for office environments and casual, daily use.

name: AVENTOS FOR HER by FRAGRANCE WORLD EDP 100ML
description:
Aventos For Her by Fragrance World is a Chypre Fruity fragrance designed for women, combining fresh citrus and green apple top notes with a woody-floral heart and a sweet, amber-rich base. The composition features contrasting elements of juicy bergamot, powdery violet, and spicy pink pepper in its opening, transitioning to a rose-and-sandalwood core underlined by animalic musk. The base unfolds with fruity peach, tart blackcurrant, and floral ylang-ylang nuances supported by warm amber.


Aventos For Her by Fragrance World is a Chypre Fruity fragrance for women. Aventos For Her was launched in 2018. Top notes are Pink Pepper, Green Apple, Bergamot, Violet, Lemon and Patchouli; middle notes are Sandalwood, Musk, Styrax and Rose; base notes are Black Currant, Ylang Ylang, Peach, Lilac and Amber.

name: AVANTI VELVET EDITION EDP 100ML
description:
It features notes of cardamom, nutmeg, cinnamon, and rose, often described as a long-lasting, sophisticated, and clean aroma suitable for daily wear and evening outings.


Key Characteristics:
Fragrance Family: Oriental, Woody, Floral.
Scent Profile: Warm and spicy with notes of cinnamon, nutmeg, and cardamom, blended with delicate rose.
Longevity: Known for being a long-lasting fragrance.
Versatility: Suitable for both men and women.
Best For: Everyday wear, office, and special occasions.
Bottle Design: Typically comes in an elegant bottle, often described as a blue and green design.

name: AVANTI FOR HIM EDP 100ML
description:
Avanti For Him is an Imperio/Baron de Bellefleur EDP fragrance (100ml) . It is described as a, clean, energetic, and sophisticated scent featuring notes of cardamom, cinnamon, nutmeg, citrus, and woody undertones, making it suitable for everyday wear.


Avanti For Him is an Imperio/Baron de Bellefleur EDP fragrance (100ml) priced roughly between ₦16,500 and ₦27,800, popular in Nigeria. It is described as a, clean, energetic, and sophisticated scent featuring notes of cardamom, cinnamon, nutmeg, citrus, and woody undertones, making it suitable for everyday wear.

name: AVANTI FOR HER EDP 100ML
description:
Often marketed under brands like Baron de Bellefleur or Imperio, it is designed as a long-lasting, sophisticated fragrance suitable for both daily wear and special occasions.


The scent is characterized by its blend of fresh, floral, and warm base notes: 
Top Notes: A refreshing burst of blackberry, pink peppercorn, raspberry, and mandarin oil.
Heart Notes: A romantic floral bouquet featuring rose and radiant jasmine.
Base Notes: A warm, lingering finish of sandalwood, patchouli, amber, and musk.

name: AURA by LATTAFA EDP 60ML
description:
It begins with the rich and warm scent of saffron, making it feel special right from the start. As it develops, it blends fresh pine and sweet jasmine, creating a nice balance. The base of Lattafa Aura EDP 60ml is warm and inviting, with amber, musk, and cedarwood, making it last on the skin. This fragrance is perfect for daily use or special moments.

. Aura was launched in 2022. Top note is Saffron; middle notes are Balsam Fir and Jasmine; base notes are Ambergris, Musk, Moss, Cashmeran and Cedarwood.

name: ATOOF by PARIS CORNER EDP 1OOML for MEN
description:
Paris Corner Atoof EDP 100ml, a bold men's fragrance with caramel, saffron, leather, and amber. A perfect balance of masculinity, sweetness.


Atoof is a decadent and luxurious blend, with the sweetness of caramel and vanilla, the warmth of saffron, the sensual touch of leather and musk, and the comforting notes of tonka and ambergris. The combination suggests a rich and inviting scent that can be both sweet and spicy, suitable for fall and winter or evening wear.

Top notes are Saffron and Caramel; middle notes are Leather and Amber; base notes are Vanilla, Tonka and Musk.

name: ASAD by LATTAFA EDP 100ML
description:
Lattafa Asad is a popular, affordable Amber fragrance for men, often recognized as a clone of Dior Sauvage Elixir. It features warm spicy, vanilla, and woody notes, making it ideal for fall/winter, with strong projection and long-lasting performance.

Key Scent Profile

Top Notes: Black Pepper, Pineapple, Tobacco

Heart Notes: Coffee, Patchouli, Iris

Base Notes: Amber, Vanilla, Dry Woods, Benzoin, Labdanum


Key Details

Best Time to Wear: Fall and winter, or as a strong evening scent.

Longevity/Projection: Long-lasting (often 8+ hours) with strong projection in the first few hours.

Variations: Lattafa has introduced variations like the bolder Asad Elixir and Asad Bourbon.

Value: Widely considered a high-value, high-compliment, budget-friendly scent.

name: ASAD ZANZIBAR by LATTAFA EDP 100ML
description:
Lattafa Asad Zanzibar is a tropical, spicy Eau de Parfum for men, offering a unique blend of coconut water, sea salt, iris, and incense. Considered a distinct creation rather than a clone of the original Asad, this scent provides a creamy yet fresh oceanic vibe, frequently compared to a blend of spices and sweet coconut.

Key Scent Profile & Notes:

Top Notes: Black Pepper, Sea Lavender
Heart Notes: Coconut Water, Iris, Salt
Base Notes: Incense, Vanilla
Vibe: Creamy, sweet, tropical, and aromatic

name: ASAD ELIXIR by LATTAFA EDP 100ML
description: A deeper, more concentrated evolution of the original Asad. The opening is sharp, spicy, and full of tension, with notes of pink pepper, saffron, and grapefruit. The heart reveals a smoky blend of tobacco and cedarwood, softened by a touch of vanilla. At its base: earthy patchouli, resinous olibanum, smooth cashmeran, and dry amber. This is trouble. And you were made for it.

name: ASAD BOURBON by LATTAFA EDP 100ML
description:
Lattafa Asad Bourbon is a warm, spicy, and woody EDP for men, often noted for its rich, intoxicating scent profile resembling aged bourbon, cocoa, and vanilla. It offers a sophisticated, intense aroma suitable for evening or winter wear. The scent typically lasts around 6–8 hours with moderate to strong projection. 

Key Aspects of Asad Bourbon:

Scent Profile: Rich and sweet, featuring top notes of lavender and pink pepper, heart notes of cacao and cardamom, and base notes of bourbon vanilla, amber, and vetiver.

Performance: Generally considered long-lasting (approx. 6–8 hours) with moderate to good projection.

Comparisons: Often compared to fragrances like Azzaro The Most Wanted or Uomo Born In Roma DNA.
Versatility: Considered a strong choice for evenings, autumn, and winter.

Target Audience: Marketed for men, though some consider it unisex.

name: ART OF UNIVERSE by LATTAFA EDP 100ML (UNISEX)
description:
Lattafa Pride Art of Universe is a fragrance that captures energy and sophistication in a harmonious blend. It opens with a refreshing burst of bergamot and mandarin, enhanced by the invigorating spice of ginger and the cool freshness of mint. The heart reveals a delicate balance of orange flower and juicy pear, adding a touch of floral sweetness and fruitiness. As it settles, the warm and woody depth of cedar wood meets the rich glow of amber and the soft allure of musk, leaving a lasting and refined impression. Art of Universe is a scent designed for those who embrace vibrancy, elegance, and effortless charm.


 Top notes are Mandarin, Ginger, Bergamot and Mint; middle notes are Pear and Orange Blossom; base notes are Musk, Amber and Cedar.

name: ART OF NATURE 2 by LATTAFA PRIDE EDP 100ML
description: Lattafa Pride Art of Nature II is a refined unisex fragrance that harmoniously blends vibrant and sophisticated elements. It opens with a refreshing burst of bergamot, olibanum, mandarin, and apple, creating a bright and fruity introduction. The heart reveals a luxurious combination of orange blossom, rose, and cardamom, adding a floral and spicy richness. The fragrance settles into a warm and enduring base of vanilla, ambroxan, guaiac wood, cedarwood, and musk, providing a deep and sensual finish. This elegant scent offers a perfect balance of citrus, floral, and woody notes, making it an exceptional choice for any occasion.

name: ART OF NATURE 1 by LATTAFA EDP 100ML
description:
Crafted to capture the essence of nature’s beauty and complexity, this Eau de Parfum offers a rich, sensual experience with bold and evocative notes that exude elegance and depth.

Top Notes: Plum, Blackcurrant, Fig
Middle Notes: Rose, Rhubarb, Leather
Base Notes: Oud, Ambergris, Vanilla


The fragrance opens with a luscious blend of plum, blackcurrant, and fig, creating a juicy and sweet introduction. The richness of plum and blackcurrant offers a deep, fruity sweetness, while the fig adds a hint of earthiness, evoking the lush bounty of nature.

As the fragrance unfolds, the heart reveals an intriguing mix of rose, rhubarb, and leather. The timeless elegance of rose is contrasted by the tart, slightly green aroma of rhubarb, adding complexity and freshness to the composition. The presence of leather introduces a warm, slightly smoky depth, evoking a sense of strength and sophistication.

In the base, oud, ambergris, and vanilla create a rich and long-lasting finish. Oud brings a deep, woody, and resinous warmth, while ambergris adds a subtle, earthy, and slightly marine note that enhances the overall richness. Vanilla softens the composition with its creamy sweetness, leaving a smooth, inviting trail that lingers on the skin.

Art Of Nature I by Lattafa Pride is a masterful fusion of fruit, florals, and earthy elements, making it the perfect fragrance for those who appreciate complexity and depth. Whether worn during special occasions or as a signature scent, Art Of Nature I envelops you in a luxurious and sensual aura, leaving a lasting impression of sophistication and natural beauty.

name: ARCHED SIMPLE MODERN WHITE AND BLACK
ARABIYAT PRESTIGE HILAL MUSK WHITE EDP 100ML
description:
Sparkling with sorbet sweetness, heady magnolia and Iranian Rose, anchored to a souk-rich swooning base of Kashmir wood, crystal amber and sensual Cambodian Oud, this is a perfume that exudes confidence and exclusivity.


The scent opens with sparkling notes of fresh citrus and delicate florals, leading to a heart of creamy vanilla and soft sugar.

name: ARABIYAT NYLA VANI-LLE EAU de parfum 100ML
description:
Nyla Vani-Elle is an intriguing perfume that evokes desire, nostalgia, and yearning. The sunny vanilla bean essence beautifully blends with jasmine to create a bright and luminous opening. The caramel in the heart notes introduces the inviting gourmand facet while amber lends warmth. In the dry down, a soft and enveloping accord dense with vanilla, and gourmand facets of tonka beans is held together by the intriguing musk.

Top Notes: Jasmine, Vanilla Bean
Heart Notes: Caramel, Amber
Base Notes: Vanilla, Tonka Beans, Musk

name: ARABIYAT NYLA SUEDE
description:
Arabiyat Nyla Suede 100ml Eau de Parfum is a luxurious and sensual fragrance that blends soft suede with warm and spicy notes. The perfume opens with a combination of fresh citrus and spicy pepper, creating a bold and intriguing introduction.


Top Notes: Coconut, Praline, Caramel
Middle Notes: Cashmere Wood, Vanilla, Milk, Ylang-Ylang
Base Notes: Leather (Suede), Ambergris, Sandalwood, Musk

name: ANSAAM GOLD by LATTAFA
description: Ansaam Gold by Lattafa Perfumes is a Oriental Floral fragrance for women. Ansaam Gold was launched in 2022. Top notes are Mandarin Orange and Pear; middle notes are Sweet Notes, Jasmine and Rose; base notes are Musk, Vanilla and Raspberry.

name: ANGEL CARE by FRAGRANCE WORLD EDP 100ML
description:
A vanilla sweet scent from Fragance deluxe that had sane DNA AAs khamrah, last up to 8hours and the dry down is epic.

Angel Care fragrance Deluxe is a very long lasting fragrance

It smells hot and unique but sweet and strong.

It is still a global best seller

For women.

name: ANA ABIYEDH ROUGE  by LATTAFA EDP 100ML
description: Perfume Ana Abiyedh Rouge Eau de Parfum by Lattafa is a soothing, harmonious perfume with amber, saffron and ambergris. The top note opens the fragrance warm and spicy with bitter almonds and saffron. The heart note forms jasmine and cedar, followed by musk, wood and ambergris in the base. A great and unusual perfume, with a subtle sweetness that perfectly interacts with the salty ambergris and spicy saffron. The perfume is suitable for both everyday and evening use. Main accords: amber, almonds, animalic, warm spicy, woody

name: ANA ABIYEDH POUDREE by LATTAFA EDP 100ML
description:
Lattafa Ana Abiyedh I Am White Poudree, This perfume is ideal for women who want to leave around them a fine and sweet scent full of purity. In the aroma of the perfume Ana Abiyedh Poudree there is a rich and sensual mixture of flowers, with delicate notes of mentholated lemon balm, for a dizzying experience that leaves you with a pleasant feeling of invigoration.
 Strong but refined notes combine to capture your senses, while enhancing your positive mood. There are sensual tones around them, and the unexpected floral touches complete the perfume with softness and freshness.

name: ANA ABIYEDH LEATHER  by LATTAFA EDP 100ML
description:
Ana Abiyedh Leather by Lattafa Perfumes is a bold and elegant unisex fragrance that masterfully blends the rich intensity of leather with vibrant spicy and floral notes. First launched in 2017, this scent has earned its place as a standout in the world of oriental leathery perfumes.
Top Notes

Juniper Berries, Cardamom, Pink Pepper, Raspberry

Middle Notes:

Iris, Ginger, Rose

Base Notes:

Leather, White Musk, Amber

name: ANA ABIYEDH I AM WHITE by LATTAFA EDP 100ML
description: Ana Abiyedh by Lattafa Perfumes is a fragrance for women and men. Top notes are Bergamot and Orange; middle notes are Vanilla and Pear; base notes are Musk and Amber.

name: ANA ABIYEDH CORAL by LATTAFA EDP 60ML
description: Ana Abiyedh Coral by Lattafa is a captivating unisex fragrance that blends fruity and floral notes with a warm, musky base. It opens with a luscious blend of peach, watermelon, and orange, creating a juicy and refreshing introduction. The heart reveals a delicate fusion of coconut and white florals, adding a creamy, tropical touch. As the scent settles, a rich base of vanilla, amber, and musk envelops the skin, leaving a soft, sensual trail. Ana Abiyedh Coral by Lattafa is perfect for any occasion, embodying sophistication and charm.

name: AMORIST by BARON DE BELLEFLUER EDP 100ML
description: A feminine fragrance,a bursts of fresh citrus notes like bergamot and mandarin, delicately blended with a bouquet of white flowers and rose, and further enhanced by soft patchouli, vanilla and musk.

name: AMEERAT  AL ARAB RED ASDAAF EDP 100ML
description:
Ameerat Al Arab carries a strong fragrance that opens up with energizing notes while having the base of jasmine, wood, musk and oud. Ameerat Al Arab Eau de Parfum by Lattafa has the perfect combination of spices, resins, exotic woods an essential oils. The root of this type of perfumes are the aromatic notes of the oriental and woody groups. The main feature of this scent is its sensuality, exoticism and intense scent.



Fragrance Notes:
Top: Basil, Cardamon, Mint.

Heart: Honeysuckle, Lavender

Base: Saffron, pepper, Jasmine

name: AMEERAT  AL ARAB PRIVE ROSE ASDAAF EDP 100ML
description: Ameerat Al Arab by Asdaaf is a Floral fragrance for women. Ameerat Al Arab was launched in 2022. Top notes are Citruses and Bergamot; middle notes are White Musk and Aloe Vera; base notes are Jasmine, Musk, Woody Notes and Oud.

name: AMEER AL ARAB IMPERIUM  ASDAAF EDP 100ML
description:
Discover the captivating allure of Ameer Al Arab Imperium by Lattafa. This exquisite fragrance begins with the invigorating freshness of bergamot, sage, and ginger, creating an energizing introduction that awakens the senses. At its heart, the scent reveals a sophisticated blend of geranium, cashmeran, and apple, adding depth and elegance to the composition.



Top notes are Ginger, Bergamot and Sage; middle notes are Apple, Cashmeran and Geranium; base notes are Musk, Amber and Sandalwood.

name: AMEER AL ARAB ASDAAF EDP 100ML
description:
Ameer Al Arab by Asdaaf is a Aromatic Spicy fragrance for men. Ameer Al Arab was launched in 2022. Top notes are Jasmine and Honeysuckle; middle notes are Lavender, Pepper and Saffron; base notes are Cardamom, Basil and Mint.


Ameer Al Arab by Asdaaf is a unisex perfume that offers a bold and captivating scent. The fragrance opens with sweet and floral top notes of jasmine and honeysuckle, which awaken the senses. The heart notes of lavender, saffron, and pepper provide a warm and spicy balance to the sweetness. The base notes feature a minty freshness from mint leaves, cardamom's unique aura, and an herbal profile from basil, creating a lasting aroma.

name: AMBRE OUD by BALDESSARINI EDP 90ML
description: Ambre Oud by Baldessarini is a Oriental Woody fragrance for men. Ambre Oud was launched in 2017. Top notes are Whiskey and Apple; middle notes are Agarwood (Oud), Leather, Violet and Patchouli; base notes are Amber, Oak and Labdanum.

name: AL NOBLE WAZEER by LATTAFA EDP 100ML
description: Perfume Wazeer Al Noble by Lattafa Perfumes is a fruity-woody, powdery fragrance for women and men. The slightly fresh and green top note offers a blend of mint, bitter orange, bergamot and juniper. Iris, dark chocolate, raspberries, caramel and pears follow in the delicate top notes.

name: AL NOBLE SAFEER by LATTAFA EDP 100ML
description:
Safeer Al Noble EDP 100ml by Lattafa Perfumes is a spicy, woody perfume with herbs for women and men. Fresh and clear artemisia and bergamot open the perfume. Green, spicy herbal notes fill the heart note. The base is earthy, resinous and woody with tiger nut, labdanum, cumin, patchouli, frankincense, juniper and guaiac wood.

Safeer Al Noble is a classic, buoyantly fresh fragrance that suits any occasion.
Main accords: woody, aromatic, fresh, spicy, amber, earthy, herbs.

name: AL NASHAMA WHITE by LATTAFA EDP 100ML
description: Lattafa Al Nashama is a rich, unisex Eau de Parfum blending fresh bergamot, spicy pink pepper and sage with a heart of juicy plum, black pepper & jasmine — finishing on warm saffiano leather, amber, patchouli and moss. A versatile, long-lasting scent perfect for day or night.

name: AL NASHAMA CAPRICE by LATTAFA EDP 100ML
description:
At the Top Notes, the scent opens with a burst of spicy warmth, featuring the exotic allure of Cardamom and Ginger, enhanced by the zesty freshness of Bergamot and Lemon. These vibrant notes create an energizing and uplifting introduction to the fragrance.
